description: Defines the IApplication interface and related enums and nested structures for application management within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace, including notifications, reset types, launch points, and properties like identifier, content link, visibility, and language.

classes.name: IApplication
classes.description: Interface for application control and information, including registration, reset, and properties like identifier, content link, launch point, visibility, and language.

nested_classes.name: INotification
nested_classes.description: Notification interface for application visibility changes.

enums.name: resettype
enums.description: Enumeration of reset types: FACTORY, CACHE, CREDENTIALS, RECORDINGS.

enums.name: launchpointtype
enums.description: Enumeration of launch point types such as DIAL, APPLICATION_LIST, WEB_BROWSER, POWER_ON, etc.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for application events.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets application data based on specified reset type.

methods.name: ContentLink
methods.description: Sets the URI of the associated application content.

methods.name: LaunchPoint
methods.description: Gets or sets the application's launch point type.

methods.name: Visible
methods.description: Gets or sets the application's visibility status.

methods.name: Language
methods.description: Gets or sets the application's user interface language.
